answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Taqleed & Fighi Schools Question ID: 46240 Country: India Title: Maslak Question: If anyone is Shafai then what they should think about Hanafi? If there are differences in maslah then which maslah will be followed? Answer ID: 46240 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1082/847/B=1434) In case of differences, a Shafai and Hanafi should follow their maslak. It is not allowed to practice the other maslak without exigent need. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
